scripts.dev: echo 'Please run backend and frontend separately:' && echo '  cd backend && npm run dev' && echo '  cd frontend && npm run dev'
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:all: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.setup: cd backend && cp .env.example .env && npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate && cd ../frontend && cp .env.example .env.local && npm install
